create_cameras: create a batched Cameras object with rotation, translation, focal length, and image size tensors
transform_points_to_camera_coords: transform world-space points to camera coordinates using rotation and translation matrices
transform_points_to_screen: transform world-space points to screen pixel coordinates using camera intrinsics and image size
unproject_screen_points: unproject screen-space points with depth back to world or camera coordinates
join_uco3d_cameras_as_batch: join a list of Cameras objects into a single batched Cameras by concatenating tensor fields
